items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One was called El Sino, where a tenor player named Paul Bascomb, who used to be with Erskine Hawkins, a famous band, played.

ctx.x: Was that a bebop environment or more a swing show?

That was more of a show time, show place there. But the Valley itself is a small area of about a three-block area, which contained several clubs. One was called El Sino, where a tenor player named Paul Bascomb, who used to be with Erskine Hawkins, a famous band, played. There was another place called the -- Sonny Wilson. That was another nightclub where a small group played. That was -- the first place where I saw Kenny Burrell was a place called the Club Sudan. It was a teenage club where they sold just orange…
